forge_native_finding: Forge GameEntity stores counters in a Guava Multiset. getCounters(CounterType) natively returns zero for an absent counter type, but setCount(type, 0) leaves no iterable entry and nonpositive add-counter paths are ignored. Therefore an explicit provider-neutral zero counter cannot be reconstructed by iterating c.getCounters().entrySet() alone.
denominator_counter_surface_finding: Across the exact WS44 provider denominator only two semantic objects carry nonempty counter maps: PILOT_TRIGGER_ORDER Mystic Remora age=0 and PILOT_CHOOSE_ABILITY Jeska loyalty=3. The exact zero-valued counter surface occurs only at PILOT_TRIGGER_ORDER.
remediation_constraint: Any repair must derive explicit zero-counter observability from provider-owned Forge state/rules, not requested counter keys or card-name special cases. The game state must not be mutated merely to preserve a zero entry.
candidate_native_basis: Forge exposes the native CUMULATIVE_UPKEEP keyword and getCounters(AGE). A bounded observer can therefore include age with the native value for cards whose Forge rules actually have cumulative upkeep, including zero, while retaining ordinary positive-counter iteration for all other counter types.
